blok.x: I wake up at half past four.
I pray Subuh with my father at the mosque.
Aku shalat Subuh bersama ayah di masjid.
I take a bath and have breakfast.
I go to school at seven o’clock.
Aku berangkat ke sekolah jam tujuh.
In the afternoon, I study the Qur’an at TPQ.
Sore hari, aku belajar Al-Qur’an di TPQ.
At night, I do my homework and go to bed early.
Malam hari, aku mengerjakan PR dan tidur lebih awal.
